# Run: target/release/litex -f examples/test_objs/sum.lit
# Cases use discarded sketch scopes; no cross-case facts.

# P01: sum(1, 1, fn(x Z) Z {x}) = 1
sketch:
    sum(1, 1, fn(x Z) Z {x}) = 1

# P02: sum(-2, -2, fn(x Z) Z {x}) = -2
sketch:
    sum(-2, -2, fn(x Z) Z {x}) = -2

# P03: sum(1, 3, fn(x Z) Z {x}) = 6
sketch:
    sum(1, 3, fn(x Z) Z {x}) = 6

# P04: sum(1, 3, fn(x Z) Z {2}) = 6
sketch:
    sum(1, 3, fn(x Z) Z {2}) = 6

# P05: sum(1, 3, fn(x Z) Z {x}) = sum(1, 2, fn(x Z) Z {x}) + 3
sketch:
    sum(1, 3, fn(x Z) Z {x}) = sum(1, 2, fn(x Z) Z {x}) + 3

# P06: sum(0, 0, fn(x Z) Z {0}) = 0
sketch:
    sum(0, 0, fn(x Z) Z {0}) = 0

# P101: negative endpoints and exact fractions
sketch:
    sum(-2,2,fn(k Z) Z {k*k}) = 10
    sum(1,3,fn(k Z) Q {1/3}) = 1

# P102: nested product and outer arithmetic
sketch:
    sum(1,3,fn(k N+) N+ {product(1,k,fn(j N+) N+ {j})}) = 9
    sum(1,3,fn(k Z) Z {k}) + product(1,3,fn(k Z) Z {k}) = 12

# P103: named function expansion
sketch:
    have fn square(k Z) Z = k*k
    sum(1,3,square) = 14
    eval sum(1,3,square)

# P104: binder substitution retains outer free value
sketch:
    sum(1,3,fn(x Z) Z {sum(1,2,fn(y Z) Z {x+y})}) = 21

# P105: every index satisfies the callable predicate
sketch:
    sum(1,3,fn(k Z:k!=0) Z {1}) = 3

# P106: algorithm terms use proved case equations
sketch:
    algo flag(x R) R by cases:
        case x = 0: 0
        case x != 0: 1
    sum(0,3,flag) = 3

# P107: symbolic constant, addition, subtraction and scalar
sketch:
    have n N+
    have c R
    have f,g fn(k Z) R
    sum(1,n,fn(k Z) R {c}) = n*c
    sum(1,n,fn(k Z) R {f(k)+g(k)}) = sum(1,n,f)+sum(1,n,g)
    sum(1,n,fn(k Z) R {f(k)-g(k)}) = sum(1,n,f)-sum(1,n,g)
    sum(1,n,fn(k Z) R {c*f(k)}) = c*sum(1,n,f)

# P108: symbolic adjacent partition and pointwise congruence
sketch:
    have n N+
    have f fn(k Z) R
    sum(1,n+1,f) = sum(1,n,f)+sum(n+1,n+1,f)
    sum(1,n,fn(k Z) Z {k+k}) = sum(1,n,fn(j Z) Z {2*j})

# P109: integer shift with legal source and target ranges
sketch:
    have f fn(k Z) R
    forall a,b,t Z:
        a <= b
        a+t <= b+t
        =>:
            sum(a,b,fn(k Z) R {f(k+t)}) = sum(a+t,b+t,f)

# P110: known numeric endpoint
sketch:
    have end Z = 3
    sum(1,end,fn(k Z) Z {k}) = 6
